title: session: prepend_received_header uses rotate_right O(n) in-place
description: prepend_received_header builds header bytes then calls data.rotate_right(header.len()) to shift the entire message body to make room at the front. For a 10 MB message this copies ~10 MB of bytes. Prefer building a new Vec from header + &data[..], or use a rope/chain structure. The current approach also means the Received header is prepended even if the message is immediately rejected by Sieve.
